//Auth: The suite registers and confirms hundreds of accounts, which is precisely what
the auth rate limiter exists to stop, so it is raised out of the way here.
This has to live in an appsettings file rather than being injected by the test
factory: Program.cs reads the limit while building the host, which happens
before WebApplicationFactory's own configuration callbacks run. Only the
sources CreateBuilder loads for itself — this file among them — are visible
The limiter's own behaviour is covered by AuthRateLimitTest, which runs under
the RateLimitTesting environment and keeps a real limit.
